findings.summary: After previous_defs changed to hold Line objects, the check `self.previous_defs[-1]` is always truthy (Line.__bool__ is true when it has leaves), so a depth-0 def followed by a dependent clause like `else:` or `except:` wrongly gets 1 blank line instead of 2; it should use `self.previous_defs[-1].depth`.

Test coverage gap: the test only covers a nested class with a body and a stub class followed by an attribute, and does not exercise a stub class (`class X: ...`) followed by a method or attribute at a deeper depth.
